name: Crystal Restore
objectiveText: Progress The Pylon table allows you to combine green power crystals with yellow power crystals . According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to heal yourself or your allies. Yellow Power Crystal  ( 10 ) Green Power Crystal  ( 10 )

perfect for my frost mage and very easily obtainable since i m low on HP:D
Health stones and mage's gems have shared cooldowns. Is it the same for this
crystal restore?

[i][small]Edited, Nov 19th  2006 at  9:05am PST by trepacha[/small][/i]
Does this share cool down with potions, bandages, healstones (warlocks), or anything else?
replies: It does [u]not[/u] share time with potions nor bandage.  Haven't tested with health stones.

Yes it shares a cooldown with a Warlock's healthstones, just like their two class quest orbs do.

The damage shield is weaker than the Imp's Fireshield, and the armor buff is overwritten by Demonic Armor. The subtraction to an enemy's armor doesn't mean much when your primary damage is spell-based. The explosives may be good if you run out of mana, but a good wand can also fill that role without the need to be replenished. If you are an engineer, you can probably craft better explosives. That leaves the spirit buff, and honestly a warlock has enough means to recharge that even a nice +30 spiri
Bandages don't really have a cooldown, they apply a debuff that prevents bandaging for a few seconds.

I'm thinking that, as a warlock, this may be nice to use in the middle of a boss fight. A Heal Over Time I can apply myself and use to life tap. It's affected by +healing, which warlocks tend to have a noticeable amount of in the form of +magic. ;)

Unfortunately, +Healing/damage is just Blizzards way of saying "boosts all spells of all schools". +healing does NOT affect items, Drain Life, Siphon Life or Health Funnel. 

However, the quest Fragments of the Past (Elite) [quest=5247] requires 5 of these crystals.

comments.body:
In order to redeem crystals you need to complete the questline for the pylons.

It starts with [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=4284/crystals-of-power]Crystals of power[/url] at J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro.

First you need 7 of each color, then examine each pylon. After that you get [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=11482/crystal-pylon-users-manual]Crystal pylon users manual[/url]

You can then go to any pylon with the appropriate crystals.
